title: RAII-clean Engram checkpoint wait test observers
outcome: The process-global checkpoint-wait observer map is keyed by an AppState allocation address and session id, and entries disappear only when notified. A test that never reaches notification can leak a sender into a later test after address reuse. Add a drop guard or stable per-state identity.
acceptance: Observer registration returns an RAII control that removes its exact entry on drop; unnotified observers cannot survive a test; parallel/order-reuse coverage does not depend on allocator addresses.
disposal_reason: NOT PLANNED (backlog triage w-930e4d333f07, 2026-10-05; Greg's approval via Engram::Advisor #293). P3/P4, never started, no holder or children, untouched since before 2026-09-21, not reliability, data safety or pilot. The record is kept; reopen or re-file if it becomes relevant.
